courses.name: Basic Assessment and Support in Intensive Care (BASIC)

providers.name: BASIC course collaboration (The Chinese University of Hong Kong)
Sir Charles Gairdner Hospital ICU (SCGH Simulation Centre)
Health NZ Hawke's Bay (Hawke's Bay Fallen Soldiers' Memorial Hospital)

courses.format: Two-day course on the essentials of intensive care for junior doctors: lectures, skill stations (airway, mechanical ventilation, shock, trauma) and tutorials.

formatEvidence.quote: This two-day course covers the essential elements of Intensive Care medicine, pitched at junior doctors entering into critical care environments.

courses.notes: Run by hospital ICU departments under the BASIC course collaboration based at CUHK. Course runners list sessions on the collaboration's registration page or on their own hospital page; some register by email only.

courses.name: TEN-360: Critically Ill Child (two-day paediatric emergency workshop)
courses.format: Two-day workshop on recognising and managing the seriously ill child: paediatric resuscitation (day 1), neurological emergencies, pain and sedation (day 2), with skills stations and simulations.

formatEvidence.quote: By the end of the two days you should be confident to recognise and initiate emergency management for the majority of paediatric emergencies you will encounter in your clinical practice.

courses.notes: Booked through the provider's Humanitix event page.
